note_en: 才能 after a condition means "only that way can": 每年至少洗牙一次，才能保护好牙齿 "you need a cleaning at least once a year to keep your teeth healthy." English expresses this with "to" or "in order to"; Chinese puts the requirement first and uses 才 to say the result depends on it.
